response.overview: An adults-only parody of the Marvel superhero universe that mixes musical theatre, aerials, dance, stunts and risqué cabaret, with send-ups of films such as Dirty Dancing, Magic Mike, Flashdance and The Greatest Showman along the way. Filmed in March 2025 at the Riverside Theatre in Parramatta, Sydney. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Disney or Marvel.
response.title: MARVELous: A Risqué Parody
